instruction: Calculate how much Blake's marks are above the class average and write the difference in cell G11. Round to 2 decimal places.

metadata.explanation: Task requires calculating difference between Blake's marks (94) and class average (53.71). Verified with Python: difference = 94 - 53.71 = 40.29.
